add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

include_directories(${VKD3D_INCLUDE_DIRS})

spec2def(d3d9.dll d3d9.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# d3d9.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/d3d9-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(d3d9_shims OBJECT buffer.c d3d9_main.c device.c directx.c query.c shader.c stateblock.c surface.c swapchain.c texture.c vertexdeclaration.c volume.c)
target_link_libraries(d3d9_shims PRIVATE wine dxguid uuid libd3dwine libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(d3d9_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(d3d9_shims)
add_dependencies(d3d9_shims wineheaders d3d_idl_headers)
add_cargo_module(d3d9 d3d9-cargo d3d9.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS d3d9_shims psdk uuid_sources)
